form_response_single_owner_ck.name: form_response_single_owner_ck
form_response_single_owner_ck.value:
("form_response"."candidate_profile_id" IS NOT NULL AND "form_response"."application_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("form_response"."candidate_profile_id" IS NULL AND "form_response"."application_id" IS NOT NULL)

form_response_submitted_at_ck.name: form_response_submitted_at_ck
form_response_submitted_at_ck.value:
("form_response"."status" = 'submitted' AND "form_response"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("form_response"."status" <> 'submitted' AND "form_response"."submitted_at" IS NULL)

recruitment_cycle_window_ck.name: recruitment_cycle_window_ck
recruitment_cycle_window_ck.value: "recruitment_cycle"."opens_at" IS NULL OR "recruitment_cycle"."closes_at" IS NULL OR "recruitment_cycle"."closes_at" > "recruitment_cycle"."opens_at"

recruitment_cycle_review_window_ck.name: recruitment_cycle_review_window_ck
recruitment_cycle_review_window_ck.value: "recruitment_cycle"."review_opens_at" IS NULL OR "recruitment_cycle"."review_closes_at" IS NULL OR "recruitment_cycle"."review_closes_at" > "recruitment_cycle"."review_opens_at"

recruitment_opening_window_ck.name: recruitment_opening_window_ck
recruitment_opening_window_ck.value: "recruitment_opening"."opens_at" IS NULL OR "recruitment_opening"."closes_at" IS NULL OR "recruitment_opening"."closes_at" > "recruitment_opening"."opens_at"

recruitment_opening_limits_ck.name: recruitment_opening_limits_ck
recruitment_opening_limits_ck.value:
("recruitment_opening"."application_limit" IS NULL OR "recruitment_opening"."application_limit" > 0)
          AND ("recruitment_opening"."capacity" IS NULL OR "recruitment_opening"."capacity" > 0)
          AND ("recruitment_opening"."minimum_reviews" IS NULL OR "recruitment_opening"."minimum_reviews" > 0)

form_kind_owner_ck.name: form_kind_owner_ck
form_kind_owner_ck.value:
("form"."kind" = 'common' AND "form"."team_id" IS NULL AND "form"."opening_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("form"."kind" = 'committee' AND "form"."team_id" IS NOT NULL AND "form"."opening_id" IS NOT NULL)

form_version_published_at_ck.name: form_version_published_at_ck
form_version_published_at_ck.value:
("form_version"."status" = 'published' AND "form_version"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("form_version"."status" <> 'published' AND "form_version"."published_at" IS NULL)

permission_grant_live_team_cycle_key.name: permission_grant_live_team_cycle_key
permission_grant_live_team_cycle_key.where: "permission_grant"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "permission_grant"."team_id" IS NOT NULL AND "permission_grant"."cycle_id" IS NOT NULL

permission_grant_live_team_key.name: permission_grant_live_team_key
permission_grant_live_team_key.where: "permission_grant"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "permission_grant"."team_id" IS NOT NULL AND "permission_grant"."cycle_id" IS NULL

permission_grant_live_org_cycle_key.name: permission_grant_live_org_cycle_key
permission_grant_live_org_cycle_key.where: "permission_grant"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "permission_grant"."team_id" IS NULL AND "permission_grant"."cycle_id" IS NOT NULL

permission_grant_live_org_key.name: permission_grant_live_org_key
permission_grant_live_org_key.where: "permission_grant"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "permission_grant"."team_id" IS NULL AND "permission_grant"."cycle_id" IS NULL

permission_grant_scope_team_ck.name: permission_grant_scope_team_ck
permission_grant_scope_team_ck.value:
("permission_grant"."scope" = 'organization' AND "permission_grant"."team_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("permission_grant"."scope" = 'team' AND "permission_grant"."team_id" IS NOT NULL)

review_submitted_at_ck.name: review_submitted_at_ck
review_submitted_at_ck.value:
("review"."status" = 'submitted' AND "review"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("review"."status" <> 'submitted' AND "review"."submitted_at" IS NULL)
